mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts higher equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% in the 20-day window or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 5.0% during a monetary tightening cycle signals unexpected easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops below 5.0% in a tightening regime
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 5.0% in the 20-day window or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly job growth (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows or turns negative, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 3.0% signals weakening labor market expectations, reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 3.0% or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in UNRATE (labor participation) and PAYEMS (job growth) signal a robust labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase in the same month
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A peak in quarterly GDPC1 followed by decline signals late-cycle demand exhaustion, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not peak or decline in the expected pattern, or 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
